source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 8 (PDF 180-204), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Plant Physiology) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define nutrient and nutrition.
(Nutrient aur nutrition ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nutrient (ghizai juz): woh substance jo jism ko metabolism ke liye zaroori ajza de.
Nutrition (ghiza): nutrients lene aur istemal karne ke majmui amal, jo organism ki growth, repair aur kaam jari rakhne ke liye hain.

book_ref.quote: Nutrition refers to the collective processes involved in the intake and utilization of nutrients

blocks.prompt:
2 Which elements do carbon dioxide and water supply to autotrophs, and why are they needed?
(Carbon dioxide aur paani autotrophs ko kaun se elements dete hain aur yeh kyun zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon dioxide aur paani carbon, oxygen aur hydrogen dete hain. Yeh bunyadi elements hain jo plants ko organic molecules banane ke liye chahiye.

book_ref.quote: All autotrophic organisms need carbon dioxide and water, which supply carbon, oxygen and hydrogen

blocks.prompt:
3 Why is nitrogen necessary for plant growth? What does its deficiency cause?
(Nitrogen plant ki growth ke liye kyun zaroori hai? Is ki kami se kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen energy metabolism aur proteins banane mein bunyadi kirdar ada karta hai. Is ki kami se patte girte hain aur growth ruk jati hai (stunted growth).

book_ref.quote: Nitrogen is necessary for plant growth as it plays an essential role in energy metabolism

blocks.prompt:
4 Write the role of phosphorus in plants and the effect of its deficiency.
(Plants mein phosphorus ka kirdar aur is ki kami ka asar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Phosphorus ATP ka hissa hai; yeh root growth barhata hai aur phool aane mein madad deta hai. Is ki kami se phool der se aate hain aur patte bhoore aur jhurri daar ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: It also plays a role in promoting root growth and favours flowering in the aerial zone

blocks.prompt:
5 Write any four functions of potassium in plants.
(Plants mein potassium ke koi chaar kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Potassium: (1) paani ke control mein shamil hai; (2) plant ke zakheera (reserve) substances ko le jata hai; (3) photosynthesis ki salahiyat barhata aur tissue ko mazboot karta hai; (4) nitrates lene ko barhata hai. Is ki kami se patton par gehre dhabbe bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Potassium is involved in water regulation and the transportation of the plant's reserve substances

blocks.prompt:
6 Why is magnesium essential for photosynthesis? Give one other role of magnesium.
(Magnesium photosynthesis ke liye kyun zaroori hai? Magnesium ka aik aur kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Magnesium chlorophyll molecule ka core (markaz) hai, is liye photosynthesis ke liye zaroori hai. Yeh phosphorus ke jazb aur transport ko barhata hai aur sugar ke zakheere mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: It promotes the absorption and transportation of phosphorus and also contributes to the storage of sugars

blocks.prompt:
7 Write the role of iron in plants. What is the symptom of its deficiency?
(Plants mein iron ka kirdar likhein. Is ki kami ki alamat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Iron chlorophyll banane ke liye zaroori hai aur energy transfer aur nitrogen metabolism ke kayi enzymes ka cofactor hai. Is ki kami se interveinal chlorosis (rago ke darmiyan peela pan) hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Iron is essential for the synthesis of chlorophyll

blocks.prompt:
8 Why is copper necessary for plants? Give its deficiency symptoms.
(Copper plants ke liye kyun zaroori hai? Is ki kami ki alamaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Copper lignin banane ke liye zaroori hai jo cell wall ko mazbooti aur sakhti deta hai; yeh nitrogen metabolism aur reproductive development mein bhi shamil hai aur enzymes ka cofactor hai. Kami: chlorosis, mure hue patte aur ruki growth.

book_ref.quote: Its deficiency can result in chlorosis, twisted leaves and stunted growth

blocks.prompt:
9 Name the seven micronutrients. Why are fertilizers added to the soil?
(Saat micronutrients ke naam likhein. Mitti mein fertilizers kyun dale jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Saat micronutrients: iron, manganese, zinc, molybdenum, copper, chlorine aur boron. Fertilizers (khaad) mitti mein is liye dale jate hain ke faslon ko macro aur micronutrients milen.

book_ref.quote: Fertilizers are added to the soil to provide macro and micronutrients to the crops

blocks.prompt:
10 What are insectivorous plants? Name three examples.
(Insectivorous plants kya hain? Teen misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Insectivorous (keeray khane wale) plants keeron aur chhote jaanwaron ko pakar kar aur patton ke enzymes se tor kar organic molecules hasil karte hain. Misalein: pitcher plant, Venus fly trap aur sundew.

book_ref.quote: Pitcher plant, Venus fly trap and sundew are some of the known insectivorous plants

blocks.prompt:
11 Insectivorous plants are true autotrophs. Why do they capture insects?
(Insectivorous plants asal autotrophs hain. Phir yeh keeray kyun pakarte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Agarche yeh asal autotrophs hain, shikar pakarne se in ki growth tez hoti hai. Zahiri tor par jaanwar ke jism ke nitrogenous compounds in ke liye faida mand hain.

book_ref.quote: However, their development accelerates when they capture prey

blocks.prompt:
12 How is the leaf of the pitcher plant modified to trap insects?
(Pitcher plant ka patta keeray pakarne ke liye kaise badla hua hai?)
blocks.explanation: Patta thaili ya ghare (pitcher) mein badla hota hai jis mein kuch paani hota hai. Is ka aakhri hissa dhakkan (hood) banata hai jo munh ko kuch dhakta hai. Sakht baal gire hue keeron ko bahar nahi nikalne dete.

book_ref.quote: The leaf's terminal portion is altered to create a hood

blocks.prompt:
13 How does the Venus-fly trap capture and digest its prey?
(Venus-fly trap shikar ko kaise pakarta aur hazam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har patte ke sire par do jure lobes ka trap hai. Andar ke trichomes chhoone par lobes ko tezi se band karte hain; bareek bristles phans kar shikar ko bhaagne nahi dete. Patte ke glands ke enzymes use hazam karte hain aur products jazb hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The trapped insect is then digested by the enzymes secreted from the glands on the leaf surface

blocks.prompt:
14 How does sundew catch insects?
(Sundew keeray kaise pakarta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sundew ke patton par chhote tentacle jaise baal hote hain, har aik ki nok par gland aur dew ka aik qatra. Boo se aaye keeray tentacles mein phans jate hain, enzymes unhein hazam karte hain aur products jazb hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Each leaf has gland and has a single drop of dew at the tip

blocks.prompt:
15 What are stomata? Describe their guard cells.
(Stomata kya hain? In ke guard cells bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Stomata plant tissues mein chhote surakh hain jo gason ke tabadle ke liye zaroori hain, aam tor par patton aur kuch tanon mein. Har stoma ko guard cells gherte hain jo bean ki shakal ke, chloroplasts wale hain aur mahol ke mutabiq surakh kholte aur band karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The stomata are surrounded by specialized cells or the guard cells

blocks.prompt:
16 Why do stomata open during daylight and close at night?
(Stomata din mein kyun khulte aur raat ko kyun band hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Din mein stomata khulte hain taake photosynthesis ke liye CO₂ andar aaye. Raat ko photosynthesis ruk jati hai, is liye stomata paani bachane aur transpiration se paani ka nuqsan kam karne ke liye band hote hain, agarche respiration jari rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: During daylight, stomata open to allow CO₂ to enter the plant for photosynthesis

blocks.prompt:
17 According to the starch sugar hypothesis, why do stomata open during the day?
(Starch sugar hypothesis ke mutabiq stomata din mein kyun khulte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Guard cells din mein photosynthesis se sugar banate hain. Sugar barhne se un ka water potential girta hai, paani andar aata hai, guard cells turgid (tane hue) ho jate hain aur stomata khul jate hain.

book_ref.quote: As sugar concentration increases in guard cells, the water potential drops

blocks.prompt:
18 How does the influx of K⁺ ions open the stomata?
(K⁺ ions ka andar aana stomata ko kaise kholta hai?)
blocks.explanation: K⁺ active transport se guard cells mein jata hai aur un ka osmotic potential kam karta hai. Paani osmosis se andar aata hai, guard cells turgid ho kar stomata khol dete hain. Raat ko K⁺ passive tor par nikalta hai, paani nikalta hai aur stomata band ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: The opening of stomata in plants is facilitated by the active transport of potassium ions

blocks.prompt:
19 What is the role of blue light in the opening of stomata?
(Stomata khulne mein blue light ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Blue light aas paas ke mahol ko acidic kar ke stomata khulne ko barhati hai; is se guard cells mein K⁺ aur us ke baad paani zyada jata hai.

book_ref.quote: promoting K⁺ uptake and subsequent water absorption

blocks.prompt:
20 How does abscisic acid close stomata at high temperature?
(Zyada temperature par abscisic acid stomata kaise band karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada garmi mein jab patte ke cells murjhane lagte hain to mesophyll cells abscisic acid chhorte hain. Yeh guard cells mein K⁺ ki active transport rok deta hai, roshni aur CO₂ ke asar ko bhi, is liye K⁺ pumping ruk jati hai aur stomata band ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: This hormone stops the active transport of K⁺ into guard cells

blocks.prompt:
21 Trace the path of CO₂ and O₂ in a leaf during photosynthesis.
(Photosynthesis ke dauran patte mein CO₂ aur O₂ ka rasta batayein.)
blocks.explanation: CO₂ stomata se andar aa kar spongy mesophyll ki hawai jagahon se guzarti hai aur palisade cells mein istemal hoti hai. Banne wali O₂ palisade cells se nikal kar spongy mesophyll se wapas guzarti hai aur stomata se bahar jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Oxygen produced during photosynthesis diffuses out of the palisade cells back through the spongy mesophyll

blocks.prompt:
22 Where is the palisade tissue located? How is it suited to its function?
(Palisade tissue kahan hota hai? Yeh apne kaam ke liye kaise munasib hai?)
blocks.explanation: Palisade tissue patte ki upper epidermis ke bilkul neeche hota hai. Is ke cells lambe, ghane aur chloroplasts se bhare hain, aur is tarah tarteeb mein hain ke zyada se zyada roshni jazb ho aur roshni ki energy chemical energy mein badle.

book_ref.quote: It consists of elongated, tightly packed cells that are rich in

blocks.prompt:
23 What is the role of supporting tissues? Name them.
(Sahara dene wale tissues ka kya kirdar hai? In ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Sahara dene wale tissues plant ki banawat, sahara aur lachak qaim rakhte hain. Yeh parenchyma, collenchyma, sclerenchyma, xylem aur phloem hain.

book_ref.quote: These tissues consist of parenchyma, collenchyma, sclerenchyma, xylem and phloem

blocks.prompt:
24 What is the tonoplast? How does it help produce turgidity?
(Tonoplast kya hai? Yeh turgidity paida karne mein kaise madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tonoplast vacuole ko gherne wali membrane hai. Is ke active transport nizaam ions ko vacuole mein le jate hain chahe andar miqdaar zyada ho; zyada ions paani ko andar kheenchte hain jis se turgidity aur naram tissues ko sahara milta hai.

book_ref.quote: It has many active transport mechanisms that move ions into the vacuole

blocks.prompt:
25 What is turgor pressure? How does it arise?
(Turgor pressure kya hai? Yeh kaise paida hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Turgor pressure cells mein jazb paani se banne wala andar ka hydrostatic dabao hai jo cells ko sakht rakhta hai. Yeh vacuole ke andar zyada osmotic pressure se paida hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Turgor pressure arises from the elevated osmotic pressure within the cell vacuole

blocks.prompt:
26 Differentiate between collenchyma and sclerenchyma.
(Collenchyma aur sclerenchyma mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono sahara dene wale tissues hain; in ki walls, zindagi aur jagah mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: They provide support to the young parts of plant in which secondary growth has not taken place

rows: Secondary wall nahi; primary wall konon par cellulose se moti.
Moti secondary walls jo lignin se bhari hain.
Tana ya patta barhne ke saath cells lambe hote hain.
Zyada tar cells murda hain.
Jawan tanon, patte ki dandi ki epidermis ke neeche aur rago ke saath.
Fibres xylem mein ya bundle caps; sclereids beej ke chhilke aur akhrot ke khol mein.
Bina secondary growth wale jawan hisson ko sahara.
Asal kaam plant ke mukhtalif hisson ko sahara.

blocks.prompt:
27 Differentiate between sclerenchyma fibres and sclereids.
(Sclerenchyma fibres aur sclereids mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono sclerenchyma cells hain; in ki shakal, size aur jagah mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: Sclereids are smaller in size as compared to fibers and are present in the seed coats and shells of nuts

rows: Lambe aur silinder numa.
Fibres se chhote.
Xylem ke andar ghane bundles ya bundle caps ki shakal mein.
Beej ke chhilke aur akhrot ke khol mein.
Sahara dete hain.
Hifazat karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
28 What is lignin? Where is it found in sclerenchyma?
(Lignin kya hai? Sclerenchyma mein yeh kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lignin aik organic compound hai jo cell walls ko mazbooti aur sakhti deta hai. Sclerenchyma cells ki moti secondary walls lignin se bhari hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: an organic compound that confers strength and rigidity to the walls

blocks.prompt:
29 What is solute potential? Why is it always negative?
(Solute potential kya hai? Yeh hamesha negative kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Solute (osmotic) potential, Ψs, solute molecules ki maujoodgi se water potential mein tabdeeli ka paimana hai. Solutes water potential ko khalis paani (zero) se kam karte hain, is liye Ψs hamesha negative hai; zyada solute se aur negative.

book_ref.quote: The solute potential or osmotic potential is a measure of the change in water potential

blocks.prompt:
30 What is pressure potential? How does it increase in a plant cell?
(Pressure potential kya hai? Plant cell mein yeh kaise barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pressure potential, Ψp, water potential ka woh hissa hai jo paani ke dabao ki wajah se hai. Jab paani osmosis se cell mein aata hai to andar dabao banta hai, cell turgid hota hai aur pressure potential barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the part of water potential which is due to the pressure exerted by water

blocks.prompt:
31 Why does pure water have the maximum water potential?
(Khalis paani ka water potential sab se zyada kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Water potential paani ke molecules ki kul kinetic energy par hai jo molecules zyada hone par zyada hoti hai. Khalis paani mein paani ke molecules sab se zyada hain, is liye us ka Ψw sab se zyada hai jise zero mana gaya hai; har solution negative hai.

book_ref.quote: So, greater the concentration of the water molecules in a system the greater is the total kinetic energy

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: zero sab se ooncha water potential hai. Solute dalne se value zero se neeche (minus mein) jati hai, is liye solutions ka Ψw negative hota hai aur paani hamesha zero ki taraf se minus ki taraf behta hai.

blocks.prompt:
32 Write the equation of water potential. Between which systems can water movement be measured with it?
(Water potential ki equation likhein. Is se kin systems ke darmiyan paani ki harkat naapi ja sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ψw = Ψs + Ψp. Water potential se kisi bhi do systems ke darmiyan paani ke behne ka rujhan naapa ja sakta hai: cell se cell, mitti se jar, patte se hawa aur mitti se hawa. Gradient jitna steep, bahao utna tez.

book_ref.quote: the tendency for water to move between any two systems can be measured

blocks.prompt:
33 How are roots suited for the uptake of water?
(Jaren paani jazb karne ke liye kaise munasib hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jaren apni phaili hui shakhon se jazb ke liye bari satah deti hain. Chhote root hairs, jo epidermal cells ke barhe hue hisse hain, zyada tar paani aur minerals lete hain jo active aur passive transport se dakhil hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Roots of plants provide large surface area for absorption by their extensive branching systems

blocks.prompt:
34 Differentiate between the apoplast and symplast pathways.
(Apoplast aur symplast pathways mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono jar mein paani aur minerals ko xylem tak le jate hain; dono cells ke mukhtalif hisse istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: In symplast pathway, water and minerals move through interconnected protoplasts of root cells

rows: Saath saath cell walls ke nizaam se.
Jar ke cells ke jure hue protoplasts se.
Musalsal, magar endodermis par Casparian segments se toot jata hai.
Protoplasts plasmodesmata se jure hain jo walls ke surakhon se guzarte hain.
Paani ka asal rasta.
Kam ahem, siwaye endodermis ke ilaqe mein minerals ke.

blocks.prompt:
35 What is the vacuolar pathway?
(Vacuolar pathway kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vacuolar pathway mein paani aur minerals cell membranes, cytoplasm, tonoplast aur vacuoles se guzarte hain, aik vacuole se doosre tak, symplast aur apoplast ko chhor kar. Is raste se harkat na hone ke barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: They move from vacuole to vacuole and bypass the symplast and apoplast pathways

blocks.prompt:
36 Differentiate between tracheids and vessels.
(Tracheids aur vessels mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono xylem ke paani le jane wale cells hain; in ki shakal aur jorne ka tareeqa mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: The ends of the cells are tapered and they are linked to each other by bordered pits

rows: Lambe, patle cells jin ki walls lignin se moti hain.
Tracheids se chhote aur chaure.
Sire patle (tapered).
Seedhi qatar mein, musalsal naliyan banate hain.
Bordered pits se jure, jo paani ko pehlu ki taraf jane dete hain.
Perforation plates paani ko asani se guzarne dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
37 Write the functions of xylem fibres and xylem parenchyma.
(Xylem fibres aur xylem parenchyma ke kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Xylem fibres lambe, lignin wale cells hain jo pakne par murda hote hain; yeh xylem ko mazboot aur plant ko izafi sahara dete hain. Xylem parenchyma zinda patli wall wale cells hain jo nutrients aur paani rakhte, pehlu ki taraf transport karte aur xylem ki marammat mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: At maturity, they are dead and enhance the structural integrity of the xylem

blocks.prompt:
38 What is the TACT mechanism?
(TACT mechanism kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: TACT (Transpiration, Adhesion, Cohesion, Tension) aam tor par maana hua model hai jo batata hai ke paani gravity ke khilaf xylem se plant ke har hisse tak kaise jata hai. Yeh paani ki physical aur chemical khususiyat aur plant ke mahol se taalluq par mabni hai.

book_ref.quote: is a widely accepted model explaining how water moves against gravity through the xylem

blocks.prompt:
39 Differentiate between adhesion and cohesion in the ascent of water.
(Paani ke upar charhne mein adhesion aur cohesion ka farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono kashish ki quwwatein hain jo paani ke column ko jora rakhti hain; yeh mukhtalif cheezon ke darmiyan hain.

book_ref.quote: Water molecules within the xylem stick together, forming an unbroken column from the roots to the leaves

rows: Paani ke molecules aur xylem walls ke darmiyan kashish.
Paani ke molecules ki aapas ki kashish, hydrogen bonding se.
Paani upar jate hue xylem walls se chipakta hai.
Paani ke molecules jur kar na tootne wala column banate hain.
Column ko tootne se rokti hai, khaas kar lambe plants mein.
Transpiration ki kheench ko poore column tak pohanchati hai.

blocks.prompt:
40 How does transpiration create tension in the xylem?
(Transpiration xylem mein tension kaise paida karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab paani ki bhaap stomata se bahar nikalti hai to patte ke tissue mein manfi dabao banta hai. Yeh kam dabao xylem mein tension ki shakal mein phailta hai jo jure hue paani ke column ko jaron se upar kheenchta hai.

book_ref.quote: As water vapour exits the leaf, a negative pressure is generated within the leaf tissue

blocks.prompt:
41 What are sieve tube elements and sieve tubes?
(Sieve tube elements aur sieve tubes kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sieve tube elements phloem ke woh cells hain jo sugar aur doosra organic maadda le jate hain. In ke sieve areas mein surakh unhein jorte hain; end walls par jur kar yeh lambi qatar banate hain jise sieve tube kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: where the individual cells are joined together to form a longitudinal series called a sieve tubes

blocks.prompt:
42 What is the role of companion cells?
(Companion cells ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har sieve tube element ke saath aik ya zyada companion cells hote hain jo plasmodesmata se jure hote hain. Companion cells sieve tube elements ko ATP aur proteins dete hain; translocation mein sucrose pehle inhi mein load hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Each sieve tube element is associated with one or more companion cells

blocks.prompt:
43 Write the function of phloem parenchyma.
(Phloem parenchyma ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Phloem parenchyma sugar, resins, latex aur mucilage jaisi cheezen jama karta hai jo plant ki hifazat aur nami qaim rakhne ke liye ahem hain.

book_ref.quote: which are important for plant defence and moisture retention

blocks.prompt:
44 Give reason: diffusion cannot explain translocation in phloem.
(Wajah batayein: diffusion phloem mein translocation ki wazahat nahi kar sakta.)
blocks.explanation: Diffusion bohat sust hai. Phloem mein sugar ausatan 1 meter fi ghanta chalti hai jabke diffusion 1 meter aath saal mein tay karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Diffusion is far too slow, to account for the velocities of sugar movement in phloem

blocks.prompt:
45 Differentiate between source and sink in translocation.
(Translocation mein source aur sink ka farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Sugar source se sink tak jati hai; dono siron par ulta amal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This theory relies on the principle of osmotic pressure differences between source and sink regions

rows: Jahan sugar banti hai, maslan patte ke mesophyll cells.
Jahan sugar kharch ya jama hoti hai.
Sucrose sieve tubes mein load hoti hai.
Sugar active tor par sieve tubes se nikali jati hai.
Paani osmosis se sieve tubes mein aata hai.
Paani osmosis se sieve tubes se nikalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
46 What happens to the glucose formed in mesophyll cells during photosynthesis?
(Photosynthesis mein mesophyll cells mein banne wali glucose ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glucose ka kuch hissa respiration mein istemal hota hai. Baqi izafi glucose non-reducing sugar sucrose mein badalti hai jo active transport se companion cells mein aur phir plasmodesmata se sieve tubes mein jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The glucose formed during photosynthesis in mesophyll cells, is used in respiration

blocks.prompt:
47 Differentiate between xylem and phloem on the basis of their function and components.
(Xylem aur phloem mein un ke kaam aur ajza ki buniyad par farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono vascular tissues hain; yeh mukhtalif cheezen le jate hain aur in ke cells mukhtalif hain.

book_ref.quote: Phloem is a vascular tissue in plants responsible for the transport of organic nutrients

rows: Paani aur hal shuda minerals jaron se tane aur patton tak.
Organic nutrients (photosynthesis ki paidawar) patton se doosre hisson tak.
Tracheids, vessels, xylem fibres aur xylem parenchyma.
Sieve elements, companion cells, phloem fibres aur phloem parenchyma.
Plant ko mechanical sahara bhi deta hai.
Secondary growth wale plants mein andar ki bark banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
48 Define growth in plants. What are growing points?
(Plants mein growth ki definition likhein. Growing points kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Growth size mein mustaqil izafa hai, lambai, chaurai aur mass mein. Aala plants mein growth kuch khaas hisson, growing points, tak mehdood hai jo meristems, yani musalsal taqseem hone wale cells ke groups, se bane hain.

book_ref.quote: These growing points consist of groups of cells, called meristems

blocks.prompt:
49 What are lateral meristems? Name their two forms.
(Lateral meristems kya hain? In ki do shakalon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Lateral meristems kinaron ke saath taqseem hone wale cells ke silinder hain jo tanon aur jaron ki motai barhate hain; yeh lakri wale plants mein hote hain aur secondary growth ke liye zaroori hain. Do shakalen: vascular cambium aur cork cambium.

book_ref.quote: Lateral meristems are cylinders of dividing cells present along the peripheral regions

blocks.prompt:
50 Differentiate between vascular cambium and cork cambium.
(Vascular cambium aur cork cambium mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono secondary growth ke lateral meristems hain; in ki jagah aur paidawar mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: Cork cambium is formed in the outer layer of stems and roots

rows: Xylem aur phloem ke darmiyan.
Tanon aur jaron ki bahari tah mein.
Andar secondary xylem aur bahar secondary phloem banata hai.
Dono taraf cork cells banata hai.
Is ka secondary xylem zyada tar motai barhata hai.
Cork epidermis ki jagah le kar bahar ki hifazati bark banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
51 Differentiate between primary growth and secondary growth.
(Primary growth aur secondary growth mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein barhne wali simt aur zimmedar meristems ka farq hai.

book_ref.quote: It is more prominent in woody perennial plants, while herbaceous plants show only primary growth

rows: Plant ki lambai mein izafa.
Tanon aur jaron ki motai mein izafa.
Apical meristems ki wajah se.
Lateral meristems, vascular cambium aur cork cambium, ki wajah se.
Herbaceous (naram tane wale) plants mein.
Lakri wale perennial plants mein zyada numayan.

blocks.prompt:
52 Differentiate between the zone of cell division and the zone of cell elongation.
(Zone of cell division aur zone of cell elongation mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono apex ke peeche primary growth ke zones hain; in ke cells mukhtalif nazar aate hain.

book_ref.quote: The area of apical meristem where cell division occurs, is called zone of cell division

rows: Jar aur shoot ke apical meristem ki nok par.
Nok se thora peeche.
Cells taqseem hote hain aur tadaad barhti hai.
Cells paani lete hain aur volume barhta hai.
Cells bina vacuole ke aur chhote.
Cells vacuole wale aur bare.
Gol nucleus cytoplasm ke beech mein.
Nucleus cytoplasm ke kinaron par.

blocks.prompt:
53 What happens in the zone of cell differentiation?
(Zone of cell differentiation mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab cells apna aakhri size aur shakal pa lete hain to elongation ruk jati hai aur cells khaas kaamon ke liye makhsoos ho jate hain. In ki walls moti hoti hain aur nayi khususiyat banti hain. Yeh zone, zone of elongation ke saath hai.

book_ref.quote: After the cells have got their final size and shape, elongation stops

blocks.prompt:
54 What is bark? Which tissues form it?
(Bark kya hai? Yeh kin tissues se banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bark pakke tane mein vascular cambium se bahar ka hissa hai. Yeh secondary phloem, cork cambium aur cork se mil kar banti hai.

book_ref.quote: The region of mature stem outside of the vascular cambium

blocks.prompt:
55 Differentiate between spring wood and autumn wood.
(Spring wood aur autumn wood mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono saal mein cambium se banti hain aur mil kar aik annual ring banati hain.

book_ref.quote: It produces fewer xylem elements, which are narrower and denser, leading to the formation of darker autumn wood

rows: Bahar ke achhe halaat mein cambium bohat active.
Khizan mein cambium ki activity kam.
Chaure vessels wala bohat sa xylem.
Kam xylem elements, patle aur ghane.
Rang halka.
Rang gehra.

blocks.prompt:
56 What is dendrochronology? How is a tree's age found from annual rings?
(Dendrochronology kya hai? Annual rings se darakht ki umar kaise maloom hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dendrochronology darakht ke rings se tareekh maloom karne aur purane mausam aur waqiat ka mutaala karne ka scientific tareeqa hai. Aik spring aur aik autumn wood mil kar aik ring banati hain aur har saal nayi ring banti hai, is liye rings gin kar umar maloom hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Each year, a new ring is added, allowing for the determination of a tree's age through dendrochronology

blocks.prompt:
57 What are plant growth regulators? Name their five major groups.
(Plant growth regulators kya hain? In ke paanch bare groups ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Plant growth regulators (plant hormones) khaas chemical paighambar hain jo plants ki growth control karte hain. Paanch bare groups: auxins, cytokinins, gibberellins, abscisic acid aur ethylene.

book_ref.quote: Special chemical messengers, called plant growth regulators or plant hormones regulate their growth

blocks.prompt:
58 Where are gibberellins produced? Write any four of their functions.
(Gibberellins kahan bante hain? In ke koi chaar kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Gibberellins jaron aur shoots ke sire par bante hain aur doosre hisson tak jate hain. Yeh: (1) auxins ke saath cells barhate aur apical meristem aur cambium mein taqseem barhate hain; (2) kuch rosette plants ki bolting barhate hain; (3) kali aur beej ki dormancy torte hain; (4) patte aur phal ki growth barhate hain.

book_ref.quote: Gibberellins are produced in the apical portions of roots and shots, and transported to other parts

blocks.prompt:
59 Differentiate between the effects of gibberellins and abscisic acid on dormancy and flowering.
(Dormancy aur phool aane par gibberellins aur abscisic acid ke asar mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh dono dormancy aur phool aane par aik doosre ke mukhalif kaam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Promotes flowering in short day plants, and inhibits in long day plants (antagonistic to gibberellins)

rows: Kali aur beej ki dormancy torte hain.
Kali aur beej ki dormancy barhata hai.
Long-day plants mein phool barhate hain.
Long-day plants mein phool rokta hai.
Short-day plants mein phool rokte hain.
Short-day plants mein phool barhata hai.

blocks.prompt:
60 Where are cytokinins produced? Write their effect on cell division and on roots.
(Cytokinins kahan bante hain? Cell division aur jaron par in ka asar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cytokinins aam tor par jaron, kachche phalon aur beejon mein bante hain. Yeh cytokinesis barhate aur DNA replication, RNA aur protein banne ki raftaar tez karte hain. Yeh asal jar ki growth rokte magar pehlu ki jaron ki growth barhate hain.

book_ref.quote: They increase the rate of DNA replication and the rate of RNA and protein synthesis

blocks.prompt:
61 What are auxins? Write any four of their functions.
(Auxins kya hain? In ke koi chaar kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Auxins indole acetic acid (IAA) ya is ki mukhtalif shakalen hain. Yeh: (1) tane ki apex ke peeche cells barhate hain; (2) cambium mein cell division barhate hain; (3) apical dominance aur phal ki growth barhate hain; (4) abscission (jharna) rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: These are indole acetie acid (IAA) or its variants

blocks.prompt:
62 Write any four functions of ethylene.
(Ethylene ke koi chaar kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ethylene, plant ke metabolism ki qudrati paidawar: (1) khaas kar stress mein tane ki growth aur jar ki growth rokta hai; (2) kali ki dormancy torta hai; (3) pineapple mein phool lata hai; (4) phal pakata hai.

book_ref.quote: Inhibits stem growth, notably during physiological stress

blocks.prompt:
63 Which plant growth regulators can induce parthenocarpy?
(Kaun se plant growth regulators parthenocarpy la sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Auxins kabhi kabhi parthenocarpy la sakte hain, gibberellins la sakte hain, aur cytokinins shaz-o-nadir. Teeno phal ki growth bhi barhate hain.

book_ref.quote: Promote fruit growth but can rarely induce parthenocarpy

blocks.prompt:
64 Define osmoregulation.
(Osmoregulation ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Osmoregulation woh amal hai jis se organism paani aur hal shuda cheezon ka andar ka mustahkam tawazun qaim rakhta hai, bahar ka mahol jaisa bhi ho.

book_ref.quote: irrespective of the surrounding environmental conditions

blocks.prompt:
65 Why do some marine organisms not need osmoregulation while others do?
(Kuch samandari organisms ko osmoregulation ki zaroorat kyun nahi jabke doosron ko hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se samandari organisms ke cells ka osmotic pressure samandar ke barabar hai, is liye control ki zaroorat nahi. Doosron ko andar ka paani aur minerals ka tawazun rakhne ke liye paani ya namak active tor par lena, rokna ya nikalna parta hai.

book_ref.quote: some organisms must actively acquire, retain, or eliminate water or salts

blocks.prompt:
66 What is an isotonic solution? What happens to a cell placed in it?
(Isotonic solution kya hai? Is mein rakhe cell ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Isotonic solution ki solute miqdaar cell ke andar ke mahol jaisi hoti hai. Cell aur mahol ke darmiyan paani ki khalis harkat zero hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: A solution whose solute concentration resembles to the intracellular environment of the cell

blocks.prompt:
67 What is plasmolysis? When does it occur?
(Plasmolysis kya hai? Yeh kab hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Plasmolysis paani nikalne se cell ka sukar jana hai. Yeh hypertonic solution mein hoti hai jis ki solute miqdaar cell se zyada ho, is liye paani cell se bahar nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: As a result, water moves out of the cell which causes the cell to shrink due to loss of water

blocks.prompt:
68 Differentiate between marine and freshwater hydrophytes in their osmotic adjustment.
(Osmotic adjustment mein samandari aur meethe paani ke hydrophytes ka farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono hydrophytes hain magar in ki osmotic mushkil ulti hai.

book_ref.quote: Freshwater hydrophytes grow in hypotonic environments, where water continuously enters their cells

rows: Namkeen (hypertonic) mahol; paani cells se nikalta hai.
Hypotonic mahol; paani musalsal cells mein aata hai.
Salt glands se izafi namak nikalte hain.
Hydathodes ya vacuoles se izafi paani nikalte hain.
Paani rokne ke liye proline, glycine betaine aur sugar banate hain.
Potassium aur calcium jaise ions active tor par lete hain.
Moti cuticle paani bachati hai.
Patli ya na hone wali cuticle; aksar chhoti jaren.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Organic solutes (proline wagaira) cell ka solute potential aur zyada negative karte hain, yani osmotic potential kam hota hai (barhta nahi). Is se cell ka water potential girta hai aur paani bahar nahi nikalta.

blocks.prompt:
69 What are mesophytes? Give their characteristics and examples.
(Mesophytes kya hain? In ki khususiyat aur misalein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mesophytes darmiyana mahol mein rehte hain, na zyada khushk na zyada geela, aisi mitti mein jo paani se bhari na ho. In ki jaren aur shoots achhi tarah bane aur vascular system mukammal hota hai, khaas adaptations nahi chahiye, patte chapte, chaure aur hare. Misalein: gulab, tamatar, daisy.

book_ref.quote: Mesophytes have well-developed roots and shoots with a fully formed vascular system

blocks.prompt:
70 What are succulents? Write two other adaptations of xerophytes.
(Succulents kya hain? Xerophytes ki do aur adaptations likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Succulents woh xerophytes hain jo gooday daar tanon mein paani jama kar ke zaroorat par istemal karte hain. Doosri adaptations: patton par mom ki tah taake paani kam nikle, aur khushk mausam mein patte gira dena.

book_ref.quote: They possess fleshy stems that can store water and used when needed

blocks.prompt:
71 What is mangrove vegetation?
(Mangrove vegetation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Samandar ke kinare daldali jagahon mein ugne wale halophytes aik khaas vegetation banate hain jise mangrove ya tidal woodland kehte hain. Inhein helophilous halophytes bhi kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Halophytes growing in marshy places near seashore form a special vegetation

blocks.prompt:
72 What is thermoregulation? Why is high temperature harmful to plants?
(Thermoregulation kya hai? Zyada temperature plants ke liye nuqsan deh kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thermoregulation aik homeostasis hai jis mein organisms mahol ke temperature badalne ke bawajood apne jism ka temperature qaim rakhte hain. Zyada temperature enzymes ko denature (kharab) karta hai aur metabolism ko nuqsan deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Thermoregulation is a homeostasis in which organisms maintain their body temperature

blocks.prompt:
73 What are heat-shock proteins? Write their role.
(Heat-shock proteins kya hain? In ka kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Heat-shock proteins khaas proteins hain jo garmi ke stress (temperate plants mein 40°C aur zyada) mein plant cells bari miqdaar mein banate hain. Yeh enzymes aur doosre proteins ko gher kar unhein denature hone se bachate hain.

book_ref.quote: These proteins embrace enzymes and other proteins thus help to prevent their denaturation

blocks.prompt:
74 How does low temperature affect the cell membrane, and how do plants respond?
(Kam temperature cell membrane par kya asar karta hai aur plants kya jawab dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kam temperature membrane ki rawani badal deta hai kyun ke membrane ke lipids crystal ki shakal mein jam jate hain; is se solutes ki transport aur membrane proteins mutasir hote hain. Plants unsaturated fatty acids ka tanasub barha kar crystal banne se rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: because lipids of the membrane become locked into crystalline structures

blocks.prompt:
75 Why is ice formation in the protoplasm more harmful than in the cell wall?
(Protoplasm mein barf banna cell wall mein barf se zyada nuqsan deh kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cell wall ke gird barf zyada nuqsan nahi deti aur plant bach jata hai. Protoplasm ke andar barf ke crystals membranes aur organelles mein surakh kar dete hain aur cells mar jate hain.

book_ref.quote: The confinement of ice formation around cell wall does not affect as badly and plants survive

blocks.prompt:
76 What are tropic movements? Name the stimuli that cause them.
(Tropic movements kya hain? Inhein paida karne wale stimuli ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Tropic movements (tropisms) kisi stimulus se hone wali growth ki harkatein hain jin mein poora organ us ki taraf ya us se door mur jata hai. Stimuli: roshni, chhoona, chemicals, paani aur gravity.

book_ref.quote: The growth movements in plants that are triggered by a stimulus, are collectively called tropic movements

blocks.prompt:
77 Define phototropism. How do shoots and roots respond to light?
(Phototropism ki definition likhein. Shoots aur jaren roshni ka kya jawab deti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Phototropism roshni ke jawab mein plant ke hisse ki harkat hai jo tane ya jar jaise hisse ki ghair barabar growth se hoti hai. Shoot ki nok aam tor par positive aur jaren negative phototropism dikhati hain.

book_ref.quote: It is the movement of part of plant, in response to stimulus of light

blocks.prompt:
78 What is chemotropism? Give an example.
(Chemotropism kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Chemotropism kuch chemicals ke jawab mein harkat hai. Misaal: fungi ki hyphae chemotropic hain.

book_ref.quote: The movement in response to some chemicals is called chemotropism

blocks.prompt:
79 Define photoperiodism.
(Photoperiodism ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Photoperiodism din ki lambai ki tabdeeli ka jawab hai jo plants ko mausami tabdeeliyon ke mutabiq dhalne deta hai; aasan alfaaz mein, din aur raat ki lambai ka jawab.

book_ref.quote: Simply, it is response of plants to the length of day and night

blocks.prompt:
80 Give reason: short-day plants are really long-night plants.
(Wajah batayein: short-day plants asal mein long-night plants hain.)
blocks.explanation: Studies se pata chala ke din nahi balke andhere ka arsa asal hai. Agar short-day plant ko chhote dinon mein ugaya jaye magar us ki lambi raat ko thori roshni se tora jaye to phool nahi aate.

book_ref.quote: If they are grown in short days, but the long night is interrupted by a short light period, flowering is prevented

blocks.prompt:
81 What is phytochrome? Name its two forms and the light each absorbs.
(Phytochrome kya hai? Is ki do shakalon aur har aik ki jazb ki jane wali roshni ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Phytochrome aik photoreceptor (roshni mehsoos karne wala) protein hai jis ki do shakalen hain. P₆₆₀ (khamosh) 660 nm ki red light jazb kar ke active P₇₃₀ banti hai; P₇₃₀ 730 nm ki far red light jazb kar ke wapas P₆₆₀ banti hai.

book_ref.quote: Phytochrome, a photoreceptor protein exists in two forms

blocks.prompt:
82 What are day-neutral plants? Give two examples.
(Day-neutral plants kya hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Day-neutral plants photoperiod se mutasir hue baghair phool dete hain; in ka phool din ki lambai se azad hai. Misalein: cucumber, tamatar (aur garden pea, makai, kapas).

book_ref.quote: Flowering independent of photoperiod.

blocks.prompt:
83 Where is florigen produced and how does it initiate flowering?
(Florigen kahan banta hai aur phool kaise shuru karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Biological clock harkat mein aate hi patton mein florigen banta hai. Yeh phloem ke raste phool ki kaliyon tak ja kar phool shuru karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The biological clock once stimulated causes production of florigen hormone in leaves

blocks.prompt:
84 What is vernalisation? Is it always essential for flowering?
(Vernalisation kya hai? Kya yeh phool ke liye hamesha zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vernalisation biennial aur perennial plants ko kam temperature de kar phool dilana hai. Kuch plants ke liye yeh lazmi hai jabke kuch mein yeh sirf phool lane mein madad karta hai.

book_ref.quote: For some plants, vernalisation is an absolute requirement while in some cases it simply assists in inducing flowering

blocks.prompt:
85 Write the significance of photoperiodism and vernalisation.
(Photoperiodism aur vernalisation ki ahmiyat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh plants ke reproduction ko mahol ke saath milate hain taake saal ke munasib waqt par reproduction ho. Yeh aik species ke members ko aik waqt phool dilate hain jis se cross pollination aur genetic variability barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Photoperiodism and vernalisation serve to synchronise the reproductive behaviour of plants with their environment

blocks.prompt:
86 Differentiate between vernalisation and photoperiodism.
(Vernalisation aur photoperiodism mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono phool aane ko control karte hain; in ka stimulus aur use lene wala hissa mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: but not by the leaves as in photoperiodism

rows: Stimulus kam temperature (chilling), taqreeban 4°C.
Stimulus din aur raat ki lambai.
Pakke tane ki shoot apex ya beej ka embryo leta hai.
Patte lete hain.
Kam temperature vernalin hormone banwata hai.
Biological clock patton mein florigen banwata hai.
